summary: Huge collection of 6000+ free MIT-licensed SVG icons designed for modern web projects, easily usable with React, Svelte, CSS, and frameworks like Bootstrap.
usecases: Adding scalable icons to web interfaces without font loading issues
Design systems and UI components requiring custom SVG icons
Rapid prototyping with ready-to-use icon sets for dashboards and apps
ideas: Integrate as a lightweight icon system in a design system platform
Build a custom icon search and preview tool for developers
Combine with CSS variables for themable icon sets in dark/light mode
